sources.title: 1337Hero/Qwopus3.8-27B-Flash-ROCMFP4-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Two experimental 4-bit quantizations of Jackrong/Qwopus3.8-27B-Flash, a 27.3B-parameter dense multimodal model (qwen35architecture, 64 layers, 262K context, hybrid linear/full attention, bundled MTP draft layer, Qwen3.5-style vision encoder). Converted from the BF16 safetensors and quantized on a Radeon AI PRO R9700 (gfx1201, RDNA4).
